_comment: The CCv3 self-improvement loop's component baseline. One component is researched per daily run, round-robin (see select-component.mjs + state.json). currentImpl pointers and frontierHints are starting points the research session VERIFIES, not gospel.

components.name: Memory
components.summary: Persistent semantic memory across sessions: recall + store, BGE-large-en-v1.5 (1024-dim) embeddings, Postgres pgvector, hybrid RRF retrieval, resident recall daemon (warm ~136ms).
frontierHints: episodic vs semantic vs procedural memory

components.name: Hooks
components.summary: Lifecycle hook system (90+ hooks): PreToolUse/PostToolUse/SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/SubagentStop, context injection, guardrails, enforcement chains. TypeScript -> esbuild dist.
frontierHints: deterministic policy enforcement for LLM agents

components.name: Agents
components.summary: Specialized subagent ecosystem (36 agents: scout, oracle, kraken, critic, debug-agent, etc.) with delegation for context isolation.

components.name: Workflows
components.summary: Autonomous + orchestrated workflows: Ralph (GSD autonomous dev), Maestro (multi-step orchestration), and the deterministic Workflow tool (fan-out/pipeline/verify).

components.name: Code Intelligence
components.summary: Code intelligence stack: codegraph (SCIP/SQLite), Serena (LSP), TLDR (AST), the /code-intel facade, and the L2 context bus.

components.name: Braintrust Observability
components.summary: Observability: 4 deterministic emitBraintrustScore() signals + LLM judges, audit-enforced emit invariant, session scoring.

components.name: Doc-RAG (PageIndex)
components.summary: Tree-based RAG for long documents using LLM reasoning over a hierarchical index; on-demand (per-prompt hook disabled).

components.name: Skills System
components.summary: Skill system (200+ skills) with keyword/intent triggering via skill-rules.json and a hook-driven activation pipeline.

components.name: CLI Integration Layer
components.summary: CLI/tool integration strategy (23 tools): native CLI > OpenCLI > MCP > wrapper > browser. Agent-friendly CLI design.

components.name: Self-Improvement / Learning Extraction
components.summary: Multi-layer learning capture (L0 hook extraction + quality gate, L1 pre-compact, L2 session-end, L3 manual) feeding the memory system.

components.name: Cross-Session Coordination
components.summary: Multi-session awareness: Postgres sessions + file_claims locking, heartbeats, session identity. Gated on session-id consolidation.

components.name: Browser Automation
components.summary: Browser automation tier: Playwright MCP/CLI, CDP CLI for perf, computer-use fallback.
